en.headline: Joshua Wong pleads guilty to foreign collusion charge
en.dek: The 29-year-old activist, already serving a subversion sentence, admitted conspiracy to collude with foreign forces at the High Court on Wednesday.
body: Joshua Wong Chi-fung pleaded guilty on Wednesday at the High Court to one count of conspiracy to collude with foreign forces, a national security offence that carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.

The court heard that Wong, 29, conspired with others including self-exiled activist Nathan Law between July and November 2020 to request foreign countries, institutions or individuals to impose sanctions or engage in other hostile activities against Hong Kong or China. Wong is already serving four years and eight months for conspiracy to subvert state power arising from the 2020 unofficial primary election.
Sentencing was adjourned. Wong has been in custody since November 2020. The prosecution and defence will make submissions on sentence at a later hearing.

zh.headline: 黃之鋒承認串謀勾結外國勢力罪
zh.dek: 29歲的黃之鋒周三在高等法院承認一項串謀勾結外國勢力罪，他目前仍在服顛覆國家政權罪刑期。
body: 黃之鋒周三在高等法院承認一項串謀勾結外國勢力罪，最高可判處終身監禁。
案情指黃之鋒（29歲）於2020年7月至11月期間，與包括流亡海外的羅冠聰等人串謀，要求外國國家、機構或個人對香港或中國實施制裁或其他敵對活動。黃之鋒目前正就2020年非正式初選案的串謀顛覆國家政權罪服刑四年八個月。
案件押後判刑。黃之鋒自2020年11月起被還押。控辯雙方稍後將就判刑作出陳詞。
